text: 20 years from now, you'd give anything to be: this exact age, this healthy, back in this exact moment. Take a second to enjoy it now.
author: Rich Webster

text: If you live each day as it was your last, someday you'll most certainly be right.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Unfortunately, the clock is ticking, the hours are going by. The past increases, the future recedes. Possibilities decreasing, regrets mounting.
author: Haruki Murakami

text: Easy choices lead to a hard life. Hard choices, lead to an easy life. Hard actions, hard decisions, hard conversations. Your dream life is on the other side of discomfort.
author: Zack Pogrob

text: Nobody is coming to save you. save yourself.
author: Alex Aubry

text: The reason most people fail instead of succeed is they trade what they want most for what they want at the moment.
author: Napolean Bonaparte

text: In anger we should refrain both from speech and action.
author: Pythagoras

text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Distance yourself from the people that you don't want to become.
author: Shane Parrish

text: The only way to achieve greatness is life is to have patience, consistency, and discipline.
author: David Goggins

text: Life is short, stop wasting time on toxic people.
author: Alex Aubrey

text: Never trust a man who speaks well of everybody.
author: John Churton Collins

text: A healthy relationship is one where two independent people just make a deal that they will help make the other person be the best version of themselves.
author: Lewis Howes

text: If you want to make the wrong decision, ask everyone.
author: Naval Ravikant

text: If you are brave enough to say goodbye, life will reward you with a new hello.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: Most people don't really care about you.
author: Sahil Bloom

text: If a man knows more than others, he becomes lonely.
author: Carl Jung

text: Doctors won't make you healthy. Nutritionists won't make you slim. Teachers won't make you smart. Gurus won't make you calm. Mentors won't make you rich. Trainers won't make you fit. Ultimately, you have to take responsibility. Save yourself.
author: Naval Ravikant

text: Open your eyes, look within. Are you satisfied with the life you are
author: Bob Marley

text: Never take life seriously. Nobody gets out alive anyway.
author: Sydney J. Harris

text: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough.
author: Mae West

text: You're only here for a short visit. Don't hurry, don't worry. And be sure to smell the flowers along the way.
author: Walter Hagen

text: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

text: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
author: Gautama Buddha

text: A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
author: Walter Winchell

text: Happiness depends upon ourselves.
author: Aristotle

text: 99% of the harm is caused in your head, by you and your thoughts. 1% of the harm is caused by reality, what actually happens and the outcome. Most of the time, the problem isn't the problem. The way you think about the problem is.
author: Steven Bartlett

text: Only I can change my life. No one can do it for me.
author: Carol Burnett

text: If you do not change direction, you may end up where you are heading.
author: Lao Tzu

text: We cannot be more sensitive to pleasure without being more sensitive to pain.
author: Alan Watts

text: It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not; remember that what you now have was once among the things you only hoped for.
author: Epicurus

text: Every man dies. Not every man really lives.
author: William Wallace

text: As a well-spent day brings happy sleep, so a life well spent brings happy death.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

text: The word 'happy' would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
author: Carl Jung

text: It is far better to be alone, than to be in bad company.
author: George Washington

text: Sometimes life hits you in the head with a brick. Don't lose faith.
author: Steve Jobs

text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
author: Seneca

text: I think the only advice I can give you on how to live your life well is, first off, remember... it's not the things we do in life that we regret on our deathbed, it is the things we do not.
author: Randy Pausch

text: If you're going through hell, keep going.
author: Winston Churchill

text: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

text: Most of the important things in the world have been accomplished by people who have kept on trying when there seemed to be no hope at all.
author: Dale Carnegie

text: He who loses wealth loses much; he who loses a friend loses more; but he that loses his courage loses all.
author: Miguel de Cervantes

text: An ant on the move does more than a dozing ox.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Never tell your problems to anyone. 20% don't care and the other 80% are glad you have them.
author: Lou Holtz

text: The happiest people seem to be those who have no particular cause for being happy except that they are so.
author: William Inge

text: Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny.
author: C.S. Lewis

text: If you don't sacrifice for what you want, what you want becomes the sacrifice.
author: Unknown

text: From the errors of others, a wise man corrects his own.
author: Publilius Syrus

text: The modern devil is cheap dopamine.
author: Naval Ravikant

text: By three methods we may learn wisdom: First, by reflection, which is noblest; Second, by imitation, which is easiest; and third by experience, which is the bitterest.
author: Confucius

text: Out of my control: The Past, The Result. In my control: My Words, My Thoughts, My Response, Self-awareness, How I treat others. The Future: What others think of me, Other People's Opinion.
author: Stoic Framework

text: Do not wait: the time will never be 'just right'. Start where you stand, and work whatever tools you may have at your command and better tools will be found as you go along.
author: Napoleon Hill

text: Nothing shows a man's character more than what he laughs at.
author: Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe

text: Whatever is begun in anger ends in shame.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: The foolish man seeks happiness in the distance. The wise grows it under his feet.
author: James Oppenheim

text: A person often meets his destiny on the road he took to avoid it.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

text: You're under no obligation to be the same person you were 5 minutes ago.
author: Alan Watts

text: The best thing one can do when it is raining is let it rain.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

text: There is only one way to avoid criticism: do nothing, say nothing, and be nothing.
author: Aristotle

text: Muddy water is best cleared by leaving it alone.
author: Alan Watts

text: If the path before you is clear, you're probably on someone else's.
author: Carl Jung

text: The man who asks a question is a fool for a minute, the man who does not ask is a fool for life.
author: Confucius

text: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
author: Joseph Campbell

text: Wise men speak because they have something to say; Fools speak because they have to say something.
author: Plato

text: If you know how quickly people forget the dead, you will stop living to impress people.
author: Christopher Walken

text: There are two medicines for all ills: time and silence.
author: Alexandre Dumas

text: He who learns but does not think, is lost! He who thinks but does not learn is in great danger.
author: Confucius

text: A great man is hard on himself; a small man is hard on others.
author: Confucius

text: Nothing happens to any man that he is not formed by nature to bear.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: If you want to know who your friends are, get yourself a jail sentence.
author: Charles Bukowski

text: When we are no longer able to change a situation - we are challenged to change ourselves.
author: Viktor E. Frankl

text: If you think you're going to win, it doesn't mean you're going to win. If you think you're going to lose, you will lose.
author: Peter Thiel

text: I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: 99% of all failures come from people who have a habit of making excuses.
author: George Washington Carver

text: The harsh truth is that nothing last forever, so when you have it, enjoy it, appreciate it. Don't take it for granted.
author: Unknown

text: The cure for pain is in the pain.
author: Rumi

text: I was ashamed of myself when I realized that life was a costume party, and I attended with my real face.
author: Franz Kafka

text: Life is a tragedy for those who feel, and a comedy for those who think.
author: Jean De La Bruyere

text: If you correct your mind, the rest of your life will fall into place.
author: Lao Tzu

text: You must understand that there is more than one path to the top of the mountain.
author: Miyamoto Musashi

text: The problem with the world is that the intelligent people are full of doubts, while the stupid ones are full of confidence.
author: Charles Bukowski

text: The best way to keep a prisoner from escaping is to make sure he never knows he's in prison.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

text: Before you try to fix someone else's vibe, make sure you're not killing your own in the process.
author: Vex King

text: Many of life's failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up.
author: Thomas A. Edison

text: Death smiles at us all. All a man can do is smile back.
author: Maximus

text: We will all, someday, experience death, and become obsolete as a dead leaf falling from a tree, crushed by passers-by to ashes underlying the earth
author: Kim Elizabeth

text: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.
author: Mark Twain

text: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: An honest man is always a child.
author: Socrates

text: People will do anything, no matter how absurd, in order to avoid facing their own soul.
author: Carl Jung

text: Have patience. All things are difficult before they become easy.
author: Saadi Shirazi

text: Worrying is like paying a debt you don't owe.
author: Mark Twain

text: It is better to be hated for what you are than to be loved for what you are not.
author: Andre Gide

text: One day, in retrospect, the years of struggle will strike you as the most beautiful.
author: Sigmund Freud

text: It may seem difficult at first, but all things are difficult at first.
author: Miyamoto Musashi

text: We have two lives, and the second begins when we realize we only have one.
author: Confucius

text: You cannot swim for new horizons until you have courage to lose sight of the shore.
author: William Faulkner
